parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field. Prefix with - for descending. Allowed: id, shipment_number, status, carrier, tracking_number, expected_arrival_date, actual_arrival_date, shipped_at, num_lines, created_at, updated_at

parameters.name: filter[search]
parameters.description: Search across shipment number, carrier, tracking number, supplier name

parameters.name: filter[status]
parameters.description: Filter by status (draft, in_transit, received, closed, cancelled)

parameters.name: filter[date_from]
parameters.description: Filter shipments created on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

parameters.name: filter[date_to]
parameters.description: Filter shipments created on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

parameters.name: filter[purchase_order_id]
parameters.description: Filter shipments that include lines from the given purchase order ID

parameters.name: filter[shipment_number.contains]
parameters.description: Advanced text filter: shipment number contains value

parameters.name: filter[carrier.contains]
parameters.description: Advanced text filter: carrier contains value

parameters.name: filter[tracking_number.contains]
parameters.description: Advanced text filter: tracking number contains value
